byte_policy.raw: SHA-256 and byte size of every actual regular-file preimage; no normalization
byte_policy.canonical_code: Python source bytes only: CRLF and CR become LF; no transcoding
byte_policy.git: Git revision/dirty state uses Git canonical working-tree semantics
byte_policy.generated_metadata: motorsim/build.json is excluded to avoid recursive self-hashing
byte_policy.policy_files: Present Git policy files are raw preimages, not executable code; tracked missing policies are incomplete

source_identity.preimages: actual source files named in files; hashes do not embed their contents
